title: Chapter 1436 - 12: Endless Stairway

Chapter 1436 - 12: Endless Stairway

Chapter 1436 - 12: Endless Stairway

As the Legendary Lord, even though his true form was in the future, separated by hundreds of cycles of great destruction, a majestic crimson figure sensed that Lin Yuan's timeline had not yet concluded.

So, Lin Yuan isn't a Lord yet?

Not a Lord? Yet appearing in the Wanwei space-time that only Lords can enter?

A common temporal being entering Wanwei space-time is typically brought by other Lords.

But the aura that Lin Yuan exhibited was not much weaker than the Lords around touching the legendary threshold.

"Not a Lord, and yet has such power?"

The majestic crimson figure was filled with various thoughts, suspecting whether Lin Yuan was a backup left in the past by some other legendary ancient being.

A Time Lord can change the past, but they fear the backlash from altering the past.

While a Legendary Lord... can already change the past on a larger scale, and their ability to withstand backlash has greatly improved.

This is why the majestic crimson figure dared to act in this time-space; as long as more than a few Lords are not completely killed, the extent of changes to the past is not too great, which it can fully endure.

"Interesting." The majestic crimson figure stared at Lin Yuan, smiling and said: "Who are you?"

In the original timeline's progression, the Blood Sea Lord was severely wounded due to this incident, even stepping into the legendary tier after several hundred cycles of great destruction.

Still, it was significantly affected.

Therefore, this time the majestic crimson figure took action to change the past and eliminate the hidden dangers brought by this period of time.

Unexpectedly, there was such a surprise.

Discovering the arrangements of other Legendary Lords.

"Who is he?" The Blood Sea Lord was shocked upon hearing.

Even when facing the Tianshi Lord, the majestic crimson figure was unwilling to say more, but asked Lin Yuan a specific question?

This attitude naturally made the Blood Sea Lord realize that Lin Yuan's background was substantial and could also be related to the Legendary Lords.

Other Time Lords thought the same, realizing that what caught the attention of a Legendary Lord could only be another Legendary Lord.

"I do not know him." The Blood Sea Lord immediately transmitted to the majestic crimson figure.

Among the many Time Lords present, he knew most, with only a few concealing their identities, unrecognized.

Lin Yuan was among these few.

"Hmm."

The majestic crimson figure said no more, keeping its gaze on Lin Yuan.

It speculated on Lin Yuan's identity, guessing it was also a method of some Legendary Lord.

Otherwise, how could an non-Lord be comparable to Lords touching the legendary threshold, how could a normal temporal being achieve this?

...

Lin Yuan looked at the majestic crimson figure, who did not answer his question, instead asking 'who is he'?

"You answer me first." Lin Yuan said.

Time beings can observe future timelines but are greatly influenced, especially when it involves information related to transcendence.

"In the future, is there truly a Lord who transcends, do you not know yourself?" The majestic crimson figure sneered.

Revealing future information, especially information related to transcendence, will have profound impacts, far greater than killing a few Lords.

The majestic crimson figure naturally would not disclose it.

And in the eyes of the majestic crimson figure, Lin Yuan is most likely related to a Legendary Lord, asking questions is undoubtedly laying traps for it.

Of course, this event involves transcendence, beyond the observable scope of the timeline.

Who in that era of time beings did not know of that period of despair that left all Lords, even all Legendary Lords utterly despondent?

It was the greatest catastrophe in the endless dimensional history.

Of course, this event involves transcendence, beyond the observable scope of the timeline.

At least, none of the Lords in the current time-space know that they are about to face a time of darkness and despair beyond the resistance of the Lord tier.

"Sneaky, let me see who exactly is the 'old guy' behind you?"

The majestic crimson figure was no longer willing to continue probing, its time in this space was limited, only three or four breaths left to quickly clear obstacles for its past self.

Clattering.

The mighty blood-colored sky curtain swept again, surging toward Lin Yuan.

The simplest way to find out Lin Yuan's origin was to act, when faced with the peril of life and death, the force behind the scenes would naturally reveal themselves.

The blood-colored sky curtain permeated through the layers of space-time, blocking all possibilities for Lin Yuan to escape.

The only way to survive under the sweep of the blood-colored sky curtain is to withstand the power of the blood.

And withstanding it... the Tianshi Lord in the front had already given the answer, strong as the second tier extreme Tianshi Lord, submerged under the blood curtain, did not last even a few breaths.

This was the result of the majestic crimson figure's intent to capture alive, had it aimed to completely kill, it would likely not take even a breath.

Capturing alive versus killing is entirely different.

Even with overwhelming power, capturing alive is quite time-consuming.

Buzzing~ Lin Yuan's external cosmos formed a domain that roared, shattering inch by inch, clearly far from enough to withstand the bloody power.

In an instant, Lin Yuan was engulfed by the blood-colored sky curtain, his entire form wobbling.

"Still not actively extinguishing the main battle body?" The surrounding Time Lords were stunned.

With the lesson of the Tianshi Lord before them, trying to resist the majestic crimson figure might result in being suppressed alive.

The cost of being captured alive is far greater than actively extinguishing the flesh.

"Let me see who or what your future really is?"

The majestic crimson figure stared at Lin Yuan, with just two breaths left in its stay in this time-space.

"I am indeed not a match for the Legendary Lord."
